svg.title: Agentic Shiksha: Platform ecosystem
svg.desc: Layered view of learner, teacher and administrator experiences, agent capabilities, application runtime and managed data services. Layers group capabilities; they are not individual microservices. The teacher dashboard is embedded in the main web app. Graph memory is an optional path, detailed in figure 05. Source snapshot: 30 SEP 2026. Not a live deployment inventory.

g.text: A course-grounded teaching and learning platform, from experience to infrastructure.
